title: How different are people's daily routines?
titleTranslate: 人们的日常生活有多大不同？
text:
I usually get home around 4:00.
It's already dark outside.
I often have dinner at 6:00.
After that, I read with my parents for an hour.
That's an important part of my everyday life.
Then I prepare my schoolbag for the next day.
At 9:30, it's time for me to go to bed.
textTranslate:
我通常四点左右到家。
外面已经黑了。
我经常在六点吃晚饭。
之后，我和父母一起阅读一个小时。
这是我日常生活中很重要的一部分。
然后，我准备好第二天上学要用的书包。
到九点半，我就该睡觉了。

title: How do we celebrate birthdays?
titleTranslate: 我们如何庆祝生日？
text:
We celebrate our own birthdays.
We also celebrate the birthdays of our family and friends.
Do you know of any other special birthdays?
For example, we celebrate William Shakespeare's birthday, 23rd April, as English Language Day.
And we celebrate International Nurses Day on 12th May.
It marks the birthday of Florence Nightingale, a famous nurse.
textTranslate:
我们庆祝自己的生日。
我们也庆祝家人和朋友的生日。
你还知道其他特别纪念的生日吗？
例如，我们把威廉·莎士比亚的生日——4月23日——作为英语语言日来庆祝。
我们还在5月12日庆祝国际护士节。
这个节日纪念著名护士弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔诞辰。

title: How do you make your birthday meaningful?
titleTranslate: 你如何让自己的生日更有意义？
text:
My birthday is on 13th June.
On that day, I always eat birthday noodles with eggs.
Long noodles are a symbol of long life.
Every year, my family and I take a photo together under the big tree in our village.
I like taking photos because they help me remember fun times with my family.
This year, I want to plant a small tree for my 14th birthday.
I'd like to watch it grow with me.
When is your birthday?
How do you celebrate it?

It's a great idea to plant a tree for your birthday!
My birthday is on 28th July.
I usually have a party with my friends to celebrate.
My mother always makes my favourite chocolate cake.
Everyone sings the "Happy Birthday" song, and then I make a wish and blow out the candles.
Next, we enjoy the cake, and I open all my gifts.
My father marks my height on the door every year.
It's fun to look at the marks later.
Next time, I also want to do something different.
Any good ideas?
textTranslate:
我的生日是6月13日。
那天，我总是吃配有鸡蛋的长寿面。
长长的面条象征着长寿。
每年，我和全家都会在村里的大树下一起拍照。
我喜欢拍照，因为照片能帮助我记住与家人在一起的欢乐时光。
今年，我想为我的14岁生日种一棵小树。
我希望看着它和我一起成长。
你的生日是什么时候？
你是怎样庆祝生日的？

为生日种一棵树真是个好主意！
我的生日是7月28日。
我通常会和朋友举办聚会来庆祝生日。
妈妈总是给我做最喜欢的巧克力蛋糕。
大家唱《生日快乐》歌，然后我许愿，吹灭蜡烛。
接下来，我们一起品尝蛋糕，我打开所有礼物。
爸爸每年都会在门边标记我的身高。
以后看到这些标记很有趣。
下次生日，我也想做点不一样的事情。
你有什么好主意吗？

title: How are animals part of our lives?
titleTranslate: 动物如何融入我们的生活？
text:
The elephant is my favourite animal.
I love elephants because they are strong and clever.
They are also a symbol of good luck here.
The elephant is our national animal.
On 13 March, we celebrate Thai Elephant Day.

Elephants look very different from other animals.
They are huge.
They have large ears and long trunks.
They can pick up and carry heavy things with their trunks.

Elephants are like us in some ways.
They are very playful and love to play in the water.
They are great swimmers.
They are also clever.
For example, they can remember one another and places with food and water after many years.
Elephants are very kind too.
They look after other elephants when they don't feel well.
The big elephants also help the baby ones.

Elephants are an important part of Thai life and culture.
However, they are in danger.
They live in forests, but people cut down too many trees.
People also kill elephants for their ivory.
Let's save the forests and not buy things made of ivory.
Every elephant counts.
textTranslate:
大象是我最喜欢的动物。
我喜欢大象，因为它们强壮又聪明。
在这里，大象也是好运的象征。
大象是我们的国兽。
3月13日，我们庆祝泰国大象日。

大象看起来与其他动物非常不同。
它们体型庞大。
它们有巨大的耳朵和长长的鼻子。
它们能用鼻子卷起并搬运重物。

大象在一些方面与我们很像。
它们很爱玩，也喜欢在水中嬉戏。
它们是出色的游泳者。
它们也很聪明。
例如，许多年后，它们仍能记住彼此以及有食物和水的地方。
大象也非常友善。
当其他大象身体不适时，它们会照顾它们。
成年大象还会帮助幼象。

大象是泰国生活和传统文化的重要组成部分。
然而，它们正处于危险之中。
它们生活在森林里，但人们砍伐了太多树木。
人们还为了获取象牙而猎杀大象。
让我们保护森林，不购买象牙制品。
每一头大象都至关重要。

title: What rules do we follow?
titleTranslate: 我们遵守哪些规则？
text:
Across the country, in many schools, Every day, from Monday to Friday, Students like us follow rules!
Keep our school clean and tidy!
Be on time.
Don't be late for class.
Raise your hand.
Walk and don't run.
Keeping the rules is good for us!
Keep the rules and let's have fun!

No, we can't.
We must keep them in Can we bring our phones to class? our lockers.

No, we can't eat in class.
We have to Can we eat snacks in class? eat in the dining hall.
textTranslate:
在全国各地的许多学校里，从周一到周五，我们这样的学生每天都要遵守规则！
保持我们的学校整洁干净！
准时到校。
上课不要迟到。
请举手。
要走，不要跑。
遵守规则对我们有好处！
遵守规则，让我们一起快乐学习吧！

不，我们不能。
我们能把手机带进教室吗？不能，我们必须把它们放在储物柜里。

不，我们不能在 classroom里吃东西。
我们能在教室里吃零食吗？我们必须在餐厅里吃饭。

title: How can rules help us?
titleTranslate: 规则如何帮助我们？
text:
Help!
There are too many rules in my life!
Every morning, I have to make my bed before breakfast.
I have to hurry to school because I can't be late for school.
When I'm at school, I mustn't use my phone in class either.
And I have to wear the uniform.

After school, there are even more rules!
I have to finish my homework first.
I can only play basketball after I practise the piano.
I can't hang out with my friends on weekdays.
I know some rules are important, but this is awful!
What can I do?

Yes, there are many rules in life!
But they can help you to become a better person.

You mustn't be late for class.
That shows respect for your class and teacher.
You can't use your phone in class because you need to focus on learning.
You have to wear a uniform because it builds school spirit.

You can also think about the things you can do!
You can use your phone at home.
You can relax after you finish your homework.
And you can hang out with friends at weekends!

I know it's hard, but rules can help to make the world better.
Remember: No rules, no order!
textTranslate:
救命！
我的生活中有太多规则了！
每天早上，我都要在早餐前整理床铺。
我必须赶快去学校，因为不能迟到。
在学校上课时，我也不能使用手机。
而且我必须穿校服。

放学后，规则甚至更多！
我必须先完成作业。
只有练完钢琴，我才能打篮球。
工作日我不能和朋友一起闲逛。
我知道有些规则很重要，但这样太糟糕了！
我能做什么呢？

是的，生活中有很多规则！
但它们能帮助你成为更好的人。

上课不得迟到。
这是对课堂和老师的尊重。
上课时不能使用手机，因为你需要专心学习。
你必须穿校服，因为这有助于培养集体意识。

你也可以想想自己能做些什么！
在家里可以使用手机。
完成作业后，你可以放松一下。
周末还可以和朋友一起闲逛！

我知道这很难，但规则能帮助世界变得更好。
记住：没有规则，就没有秩序！

title: How often do you do sport or exercise?
titleTranslate: 你多久锻炼一次？
text:
Emma, Jim, and Yaming talk about the sports they do and how often they do them.
Emma and Jim seldom play ... , but Yaming ...

I play it twice a week, usually at weekends.
How often do you play football?
I seldom / hardly ever play it.
I never do.

In our group, many students like to do sport and exercise.
Lin Tao jogs every day ...
textTranslate:
艾玛、吉姆和亚明谈论他们所做的运动以及运动的频率。
艾玛和吉姆很少锻炼……但亚明……

我每周锻炼两次，通常在周末。
你多久踢一次足球？
我很少锻炼／几乎从不锻炼。
我从不锻炼。

在我们小组里，许多同学都喜欢运动和锻炼。
林涛每天慢跑……

title: How is exercise good for us?
titleTranslate: 运动对我们有什么好处？
text:
My favourite sport is swimming.
It's fun to swim and play with my friends in the water.
Also, I like swimming because the cool water feels great when it's hot.
I Kate go swimming two or three times a week.
Swimming is good for me because it keeps me healthy.
It is good exercise for my body.
I think everyone should try it!
textTranslate:
我最喜欢的运动是游泳。
和朋友们在水中游泳、玩耍很有趣。
而且我喜欢游泳，因为天气炎热时，凉爽的水感觉非常舒服。
凯特和我每周去游泳两三次。
游泳对我有好处，因为它能保持我的健康。
这对我的身体来说是一种很好的锻炼。
我认为每个人都应该试一试！

title: What do we like to eat?
titleTranslate: 我们喜欢吃什么？
text:
I usually have some bread and milk.
What do you usually have for breakfast?
Sometimes I have eggs and beans.
textTranslate:
我通常早餐吃一些面包，喝牛奶。
你早餐通常吃什么？
有时我会吃鸡蛋和豆子。

title: How do we make healthy eating choices?
titleTranslate: 我们如何作出健康的饮食选择？
text:
Healthy eating is important for a healthy body and mind.
Both what we eat and how we eat are important!

For example, some people have fast food every week.
It is easy and delicious!
But it often has lots of salt, fat, and sugar.
That makes us put on weight.
Eating fast food like pizza and hamburgers too often may cause heart problems later.
If you cook your own meals instead, you can make healthy balanced meals.

Eating three meals a day is important.
But some people don't have breakfast.
Maybe they don't feel hungry in the morning, or they are too busy to eat anything.
But food gives us energy.
If we don't eat breakfast, it is easy to feel sleepy.
It is also hard to focus on our work or studies.

Some people also eat too many sweet things.
Ice cream, sweets, and chocolate are delicious, but they usually have lots of sugar.
This can cause tooth problems.
When you want a snack, why don't you have some fruit instead?
After all, an apple a day keeps the doctor away.

Remember: You are what you eat.
Healthy eating means eating healthy food and having good eating habits.

I have some good eating habits.
I eat three meals a day, and I have them on time.
I eat a lot of vegetables too.
Some of my friends don't like carrots or other vegetables, and they don't eat them, but I eat all kinds of vegetables.

However, I have some bad eating habits too.
First, I drink too many soft drinks.
I love soft drinks because they taste so good!
But soft drinks usually have a lot of sugar.
They're bad for me.
Second, I don't drink enough water.
I drink water when I am thirsty, but it's better to drink before I get thirsty.
In future, I should drink more water.
textTranslate:
健康饮食对身心健康都很重要。
我们吃什么以及怎样吃都很重要！

例如，有些每周都吃快餐。
又简单又美味！
但这类食物通常含有大量盐、脂肪和糖。
这会使我们体重增加。
过于频繁地食用比萨、汉堡等快餐，日后可能导致心脏问题。
如果改为自己做饭，就能做出健康均衡的饭菜。

每天吃三餐很重要。
但有些人早餐不吃。
也许他们早晨不觉得饿，或者忙得顾不上吃东西。
但食物能为我们提供能量。
如果不吃早餐，我们很容易感到困倦。
我们也很难集中精力工作或学习。

有些人还吃太多甜食。
冰淇淋、糖果和巧克力很美味，但通常含有大量糖。
这可能导致牙齿问题。
想吃零食时，为什么不吃些水果呢？
毕竟，每天吃一个苹果，医生就会远离你。

记住：你吃什么，就成为什么样的人。
健康饮食意味着吃健康的食物，养成良好的饮食习惯。

我有一些良好的饮食习惯。
我每天吃三餐，而且按时吃。
我也吃很多蔬菜。
我的一些朋友不喜欢胡萝卜或其他蔬菜，所以不吃，但我吃各种各样的蔬菜。

不过，我也有一些不良的饮食习惯。
第一，我喝太多软饮料。
我喜欢软饮料，因为它们喝起来太美味了！
但软饮料通常含有大量糖。
它们对我有害。
第二，我喝水不够。
我口渴时才喝水，但最好在口渴之前就喝水。
今后，我应该多喝水。

title: How do we buy things in different ways?
titleTranslate: 我们如何用不同的方式购物？
text:
My name is Mike.
I'm 12 years old.
I'm from the US.
My parents work in China.
I live with my parents and go to a middle school.
I often go shopping with my parents.
It's fun to go to the shops.
I can see many products there.
I can talk to the assistants about the products.
After buying some things, I can take them home and use them right away.

I'm Cindy.
I'm 13 years old.
I'm from Canada.
My mother often buys things on the internet, because online shopping is very convenient.
It's also very popular.
She doesn't have to spend much time going to the shopping malls.
During some special festivals, many kinds of products from online stores are on sale.
However, it's important to buy what you need, not what you want.
Don't spend too much time or money on the internet.

My father is a bin worker.
I usually don't see him in the morning because he gets up at 4:00 a.m.
He has something to eat and then goes to work.
By 5:00, he is at his first house to empty rubbish bins into a lorry.
Work ends around 3:00 p.m.
Then he comes to school to pick me up at 4:30.
We talk a lot on the way home.
Dinner is at 6:00.
After dinner, he watches TV for a while.
Then he goes to bed early at 8:30.
We try to keep quiet at night so he sleeps well.
textTranslate:
我叫迈克。
我12岁。
我来自美国。
我的父母在中国工作。
我和父母住在一起，在一所中学上学。
我经常和父母一起去购物。
去商店购物很有趣。
我能在那里看到许多商品。
我可以就商品与售货员交谈。
买了些东西后，我可以把它们带回家，马上使用。

我叫辛迪。
我13岁。
我来自加拿大。
我妈妈经常在网上购物，因为网上购物非常方便。
网上购物也很流行。
她不必花很多时间去购物中心。
在一些特殊节日期间，网上商店出售许多种类的打折商品。
不过，重要的不是买你想要的，而是买你需要的。
不要在互联网上花费太多时间或金钱。

我爸爸是一名垃圾清运工。
早晨我通常见不到他，因为他4:00 a.m.起床。
他吃点东西，然后去上班。
到5:00，他就在第一户人家那里，把垃圾桶里的垃圾倒进货车。
工作大约在3:00 p.m.结束。
然后他4:30到学校接我。
回家的路上，我们聊了很多。
晚餐在6:00。
晚饭后，他看一会儿电视。
然后他8:30就早早上床睡觉。
夜里我们尽量保持安静，让他睡得好。

title: A Day in China's Space Station
titleTranslate: 中国空间站的一天
text:
Being an astronaut on China's space station is really cool!
There are usually three astronauts living and working in China's space station.
Let's look at their daily routines in space.

Would you like to live and work in China's space station?
That would be an amazing experience.
textTranslate:
成为中国空间站上的航天员真是太酷了！
中国空间站通常有三名航天员生活和工作。
让我们来看看他们在太空中的日常生活。

你愿意在中国空间站生活和工作吗？
那将是一段非凡的经历。

title: Unit 2 · The Chinese Zodiac
titleTranslate: 第二单元 · 十二生肖
text:
A long time ago, people didn't know their birth years and could not remember their ages.
The Jade Emperor then wanted to choose twelve animals as the Chinese zodiac, one animal for each year.
How would he do?
He asked all animals to join a race.
The first twelve animals won the race.
These animals are rat, ox, tiger, rabbit, dragon, snake, horse, goat, monkey, rooster, dog, and pig.

Now every Chinese person is connected with a zodiac animal.
What is your zodiac animal?
textTranslate:
很久以前，人们不知道自己的出生年份，也无法记住自己的年龄。
玉帝于是想选出十二种动物作为十二生肖，每种动物代表一年。
他会怎么做呢？
他邀请所有动物参加一场比赛。
前十二名动物赢得了比赛。
这些动物分别是鼠、牛、虎、兔、龙、蛇、马、羊、猴、鸡、狗和猪。

现在，每个中国人都与一种生肖动物相连。
你的生肖动物是什么？

title: Unit 3 · The Amazing Octopus
titleTranslate: 第三单元 · 了不起的章鱼
text:
The octopus's body is very interesting.
All octopuses have eight arms.
Their brain is not just in their head, but also in their arms!
This helps them to think about and do more than one thing at once.
Octopuses can also fit into small places because they do not have any bones!
And did you know that octopuses have three hearts?
These hearts work with different parts of the body.

Octopuses can also do many amazing things.
Most of them can change their colour and shape to look like plants or other sea animals, and they can also make ink.
They keep it inside a very small bag in their body.
When they produce ink, the ink makes it hard for other animals to see them.
This helps the octopuses to get away fast.
What's more, when an octopus loses an arm, it can grow it back!

Studying amazing animals like the octopus is important because we can learn a lot from them.
But they also show us how wonderful nature is and why it is important to protect it!
textTranslate:
章鱼的身体非常有趣。
所有章鱼都有八条腕。
它们的脑不仅位于头部，也分布在腕足上！
这使它们能够同时思考并做不止一件事。
章鱼还能够钻进狭小的地方，因为它们没有任何骨头！
你知道吗，章鱼有三个心脏？
这些心脏分别与身体的不同部位协同工作。

章鱼还能做出许多令人惊叹的事情。
大多数章鱼都能改变颜色和形状，伪装成植物或其他海洋动物，而且还能喷出墨汁。
它们把墨汁储存在身体内一个非常小的囊中。
当它们喷出墨汁时，墨汁会使其他动物难以看见它们。
这有助于章鱼迅速逃走。
更重要的是，章鱼失去一条腕后，还能重新长出来！

研究章鱼这样奇妙的动物很重要，因为我们可以从它们身上学到很多。
但它们也让我们看到大自然多么奇妙，以及保护大自然为什么重要！

title: Unit 3 · Giant Panda National Park
titleTranslate: 第三单元 · 大熊猫国家公园
text:
Do you know there is a kind of animal that can be found in China?
It's a symbol of China—the panda!
However, pandas are quite rare in the world.
That's why China has set up the Giant Panda National Park to protect them.
With more than 27,000 square kilometres, the park covers the provinces of Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Gansu.

In the park, pandas enjoy a happy life.
They eat bamboo, play with each other, and climb trees.

China is the home of giant pandas.
This park protects not only pandas but also various natural resources.
textTranslate:
你知道吗，有一种动物在中国也能找到？
它是中国的象征——大熊猫！
然而，大熊猫在世界上相当稀少。
因此，中国建立了大熊猫国家公园来保护它们。
公园面积超过27,000平方公里，横跨四川、陕西和甘肃三省。

在公园里，大熊猫过着幸福的生活。
它们吃竹子、互相嬉戏，还会爬树。

中国是大熊猫的家园。
这座公园不仅保护大熊猫，也保护各种自然资源。

title: Unit 4 · Keep to the Rules
titleTranslate: 第四单元 · 遵守规则
text:
Mencius once said, "Even with Li Lou's keen vision and Lu Ban's skill, they cannot draw either squares or circles without using a ruler or a compass."
Li Lou was a man with good eyesight, and Lu Ban was a man with good skill of hand.
Mencius believed that people could not draw a fine circle or a square without tools even with great talent such as the talents Lu Ban and Li Lou had.

The saying tells us that nothing can be done if there are no rules to go by.
Rules put the world in order.
There are many rules that we should keep to, such as rules in the library, in the classroom, or in the hospital.
Can you share some more rules in your family?
textTranslate:
孟子曾说：“即使有离娄的明目和鲁班的手艺，不使用直尺和圆规，也不能画出方形或圆形。”
离娄是一个目光敏锐的人，鲁班则是一个手艺高超的人。
孟子认为，即使拥有鲁班和离娄那样的天赋，人们不借助工具也无法画出精确的圆形或方形。

这句话告诉我们，没有规矩，就什么事情也做不成。
规矩使世界井然有序。
我们应该遵守许多规则，例如图书馆、教室和医院里的规则。
你能分享一些你们家的规矩吗？

title: Unit 5 · Healthy Body, Healthy Mind
titleTranslate: 第五单元 · 健康的身体，健康的头脑
text:
We all know exercise is important, yet we don't always want to do it!
Often we are too busy or feel lazy.
But we should try our best to exercise every day.

Exercise is good for our body.
When we exercise, our body changes.
Exercise develops our muscles and makes us stronger.
When we exercise, we use energy.
This keeps our weight down.
Being overweight puts stress on our body.
It can cause pain in our back and knees, and even cause more serious problems such as heart disease later in life.

Exercise is also great for our brain.
During exercise, our heart beats faster and we breathe harder.
Our brain gets more oxygen because of this, and that helps our memory improve.
Scientists also tell us the body makes more of certain chemicals after exercise.
This helps us to learn and think well.
So, when you have trouble with your homework, do some exercise, then try again!

Exercise also helps us to feel happier.
When we exercise, our brain makes special chemicals.
These chemicals can relax our body and calm our mind.
Feeling fit can also make us feel better and more confident about ourselves.
When we play a sport with others, we can even make new friends.

Remember: Health is wealth.
The more you exercise, the healthier you become.
Try to make exercise a part of your life.
textTranslate:
我们都知道运动很重要，但我们并不总是愿意运动！
很多时候，我们不是太忙，就是觉得懒。
但我们应该尽力每天运动。

运动有益于我们的身体健康。
运动时，我们的身体会发生变化。
运动能锻炼肌肉，使我们更强壮。
运动时，我们会消耗能量。
这有助于控制我们的体重。
体重超重会给身体造成负担。
这可能引起背部和膝盖疼痛，甚至在日后引发心脏病等更严重的问题。

运动对我们的大脑也大有好处。
运动时，我们的心跳加快，呼吸也变得急促。
这样一来，我们的大脑会获得更多氧气，有助于提高记忆力。
科学家还告诉我们，运动后，身体会产生更多的某些化学物质。
这有助于我们更好地学习和思考。
所以，当你在作业上遇到困难时，先去运动一下，然后再试一次！

运动还能帮助我们感到更快乐。
运动时，我们的大脑会产生特殊的化学物质。
这些化学物质能使我们的身体放松，使我们的头脑平静。
身体强健也能让我们感觉更好，并对自己更加自信。
和他人一起参加体育运动时，我们甚至能结交新朋友。

请记住：健康就是财富。
锻炼得越多，我们就会越健康。
努力把锻炼融入生活。

title: Unit 5 · Taijiquan: A Good Exercise
titleTranslate: 第五单元 · 太极拳：一种好运动
text:
On 17th December, 2020, taijiquan, also known as Tai Chi, was added to the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO.
Taijiquan is not just a form of martial arts, but also represents the harmony and unity of nature and man.

As one kind of traditional Chinese culture, it attracts people from all around the world.
Taijiquan is popular in over 150 countries.
People of all ages practise taijiquan to keep fit and relax.
textTranslate:
2020年12月17日，太极拳（又称“太极”）被联合国教科文组织列入《人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录》。
太极拳不仅是一种武术，也体现了人与自然的和谐统一。

作为一种中国传统文化，它吸引着世界各地的人们。
太极拳在150多个国家广受欢迎。
各年龄层的人们都通过练太极拳来保持健康和放松身心。

title: Unit 6 · Food Myths
titleTranslate: 第六单元 · 食品误区
text:
The human body needs to eat many different types of food to stay healthy.
The Chinese Food Guide Pagoda shows us what food we should eat.
While fruit and vegetables are healthy choices, it is just as important to eat foods from other food groups.
Milk, for example, contains many nutrients and is good for our bones.
We should include milk or dairy products among the things we eat.

Eating fat is important for keeping us healthy.
It gives us energy and helps our body to take in nutrients.
Not all fat makes us gain weight.
Some fat can even encourage our body to lose weight.
It is necessary to include some, but not too much, fat in our food to help our body work well.

When we are young, it might feel like we can just eat whatever we want!
For example, sweets and fried foods taste delicious.
But we cannot eat those foods alone.
Eating balanced meals is very important when we are young.
It helps our body and brain to grow well.
Bad eating habits may stay with us our whole life, so it is best to develop good eating habits early!
textTranslate:
人体需要摄入多种不同类型的食物，才能保持健康。
《中国居民膳食指南》向我们展示了应该吃哪些食物。
水果和蔬菜是健康的选择，但摄入其他食物类别的食品也同样重要。
例如，牛奶含有丰富的营养素，有利于骨骼健康。
我们日常的饮食中应包括牛奶或乳制品。

摄入脂肪对保持健康很重要。
脂肪为我们提供能量，并帮助身体吸收营养素。
并非所有脂肪都会使我们体重增加。
有些脂肪甚至能促进身体减轻体重。
饮食中适量摄入脂肪，但不可过量，有助于身体健康。

年轻时，我们可能觉得自己想吃什么都可以！
例如，糖果和油炸食品味道很美味。
但我们不能只吃这些食品。
年轻时，保持膳食均衡非常重要。
这有助于我们的身体和大脑健康成长。
不良的饮食习惯可能会伴随我们一生，因此最好从小养成良好的饮食习惯！

title: Unit 6 · Guotie, a Taste of Home
titleTranslate: 第六单元 · 锅贴：家乡的味道
text:
Every place has its own special food.
It always gives people a warm feeling of home.
Guotie is the kind of special food that can give people such a feeling.
As a kind of dumpling, it is very popular in many places.

There are many folk stories about guotie.
One is from an emperor in the Song Dynasty.
The emperor didn't want to eat anything because his mother died.
One day, when he walked around the garden, he found that someone was frying some dumplings in a pan, and they smelt very good.
So the emperor decided to eat them.
These fried dumplings tasted delicious.
The emperor asked the cook about the name of them, but the cook could not answer.
Then the emperor gave the name guotie to the food.

For many people, guotie is more than just food.
It is also a taste of home and a symbol of good luck.
textTranslate:
每个地方都有自己的特色食物。
家乡特色食物总能给人带来温暖的归属感。
锅贴就是能给人带来这种感受的特色食物。
作为一种饺子，锅贴在许多地方都很受欢迎。

锅贴有许多民间传说。
其中一个传说与宋朝的一位皇帝有关。
皇帝的母亲去世后，他什么都不想吃。
一天，他在花园里散步时，发现有人正在平锅里煎饺子，香味扑鼻。
于是，皇帝决定尝尝这些饺子。
这些煎饺味道十分美味。
皇帝询问厨子这些饺子的名称，但厨子答不上来。
于是，皇帝为这种食物取名为“锅贴”。

对许多人来说，锅贴不仅仅是食物。
它还承载着家乡的味道，象征着好运气。

title: Unit 7 · Online Shopping Tips
titleTranslate: 第七单元 · 网购小贴士
text:
Do you want to buy something online?
If you do, here are some steps you can follow to get the right products at good prices.

First, plan your budget.
Ask yourself, "How much money am I willing to spend?"
Remember to consider shipping costs too.
And be careful not to spend too much.

Next, decide what's important to you.
Is it how the product looks or how much it costs?
What must the product have?
This will help you pick the product that fits your needs.

Third, take a few minutes to compare the products.
On your computer, type the product name into a search box along with the word "review".
Then read what other people say about the products online.
Look for reviews about the products you want and choose the right one.

Fourth, look for the total cost of the products.
Compare prices from different websites and check if you can get free shipping.

Lastly, choose secure ways to pay.
Don't just set a very simple password.
It's important to have a password with letters and numbers for better security.
Also, only shop on websites that are trusted and have a good reputation.

By following these steps, you can make your online shopping experience safe and fun.
textTranslate:
你想在网上购物吗？
如果想，你可以按照以下步骤，以优惠的价格买到合适的商品。

第一步，制定你的预算。
问问自己：“我愿意花多少钱？”
记得也要考虑运费。
同时要注意不要花费过多。

第二步，确定对你而言重要的是什么。
是商品的外观，还是商品的价格？
商品必须具备哪些特点？
这将帮助你挑选符合自己需求的商品。

第三步，花几分钟比较一下商品。
在电脑上，在搜索框中输入商品名称，同时输入“评论”一词。
然后阅读其他人在网上对这些商品的评价。
查找你想买的商品的相关评论，并选出合适的商品。

第四步 查看商品的总成本。
比较不同网站的价格，并查看是否可以免运费。

最后，选择安全的支付方式。
不要只设置一个非常简单的密码。
使用包含字母和数字的密码对于提高安全性很重要。
另外，只在值得信赖、口碑良好的网站上购物。

按照这些步骤，你可以让网上购物既安全又愉快。

title: Unit 7 · Grandma's First Online Shopping Adventure
titleTranslate: 第七单元 · 奶奶的第一次网购之旅
text:
My grandma lives in a quiet town in China.
She always buys things at the small market near her home.
She likes to touch the vegetables and talk to the sellers.
"Fresh food is the best!" she says.

One evening, we were watching TV.
A model on the screen wore a beautiful pink silk scarf.
"This scarf is so pretty!
But the market doesn't have it." grandma said.
I smiled and said, "Let's try online shopping, grandma!
You can find it on your phone."

The next day, I helped her download a shopping app on her phone.
The screen had lots of pictures and words.
Grandma said, "Wow, this is too much!"
But when she saw the pink scarf, her face got happy!
She clicked on the picture and read: "100% silk.
Soft and colourful."
Grandma asked, "How do I pay?"
I showed her how to use online payment.
She typed her address carefully.
"Is this right?" she asked.
I nodded.

Three days later, a package arrived!
Grandma opened it and saw the scarf.
She tried it on and got excited.
"I love it!
Online shopping is amazing!"

Jane: My family really likes pizza and salad for dinner.
After that we sometimes have ice cream or cookies for a treat!
textTranslate:
我的奶奶住在中国一个安静的小镇上。
她总是去家附近的小市场买东西。
她喜欢摸摸蔬菜，和售货员聊聊天。
“新鲜的食物才是最好的！”她说。

一天晚上，我们正在看电视。
屏幕上一位模特戴着一条漂亮的粉色丝巾。
“这条丝巾真漂亮！
可是市场里没有。”奶奶说。
我笑着说：“奶奶，我们来网上购物吧！
你可以在手机上找到它。”

第二天，我帮她在手机上下载了一个购物软件。
屏幕上有许多图片和文字。
奶奶说：“哇，这也太多了！”
但是，当她看到那条粉色丝巾时，脸上露出了笑容！
她点开图片，读到：“100%丝绸。
柔软又鲜艳。”
奶奶问：“我该怎么付款？”
我教她如何使用网上支付。
她仔细地输入了自己的地址。
“这样对吗？”她问。
我点了点头。

三天后，一个包裹送到了！
奶奶打开包裹，看到了那条丝巾。
她试戴了一下，兴奋极了。
“我太喜欢了！
网上购物太棒了！”

简：我家人晚餐很爱吃披萨和沙拉。
之后，我们有时还会吃冰淇淋或饼干作为饭后甜点！
